ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge clock for processes that update key_mem and xtea fields; it sequences CSR writes and xtea state captures used by the core.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) checks in csr_write_access and xtea_core processes (clocked assignments to key_mem and xtea fields).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: When '0' it forces key_mem and all xtea fields to zero in the reset branches, overriding normal updates in the clocked processes.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in csr_write_access and xtea_core reset the key_mem and xtea fields to zeros.

ports.name: start_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at a clock edge together with rtype_i=r3type_c it triggers capturing rs1/rs2 into xtea.opa/opb and sets xtea.done(0) to begin a round.
ports.evidence: if (start_i = '1') and (rtype_i = r3type_c) then xtea.opa <= rs1_i; xtea.opb <= rs2_i; xtea.done(0) <= '1' in xtea_core.

ports.name: active_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced anywhere in this source; it does not affect any internal element here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of active_i appear outside its declaration.

ports.name: csr_we_i
ports.functionality: Gates writes into key_mem at the addressed index on the rising clock edge; when '1' the csr_wdata_i value is captured into key_mem(csr_addr_i).
ports.evidence: if (csr_we_i = '1') then key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) <= csr_wdata_i; in csr_write_access process.

ports.name: csr_addr_i
ports.functionality: Indexes key_mem for CSR writes and reads; its value selects which key_mem element is written or presented on csr_rdata_o.
ports.evidence: Used as key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) in csr_write_access and csr_rdata_o <= key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))).

ports.name: csr_wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the 32-bit data captured into key_mem at the addressed index when csr_we_i is asserted on a rising clock edge.

ports.name: csr_rdata_o
ports.functionality: Continuously outputs the key_mem element selected by csr_addr_i to the CSR read port as a 32-bit vector.

ports.name: rtype_i
ports.functionality: Controls whether a start captures operands into the XTEA core and governs which result path is selected in the result_select process.
ports.evidence: Used in start condition in xtea_core and tested in result_select if (rtype_i = r3type_c) to choose outputs.

ports.name: funct3_i
ports.functionality: Selects which XTEA sub-operation to perform: it gates sum/res update behavior, chooses operand ordering for tmp signals, and is the case selector for result_o/valid_o outputs.
ports.evidence: funct3_i bits are tested in xtea_core for sum/res updates, used in when-else concurrent assigns for tmp_*, and as case selector in result_select.

ports.name: funct7_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source; it has no effect on internal logic here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of funct7_i beyond its declaration.

ports.name: rs1_i
ports.functionality: Captured into xtea.opa on a start event and provides one operand used by subsequent tmp computations and the XTEA core.
ports.evidence: xtea.opa <= rs1_i executed in the start branch inside xtea_core on rising edge.

ports.name: rs2_i
ports.functionality: Captured into xtea.opb on a start event and supplies the other operand for tmp computations and the XTEA core.
ports.evidence: xtea.opb <= rs2_i in the start branch of xtea_core process.

ports.name: rs3_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this source; it does not affect internal computation here.
ports.evidence: rs3_i appears only in the port declaration and nowhere else in the source.

ports.name: result_o
ports.functionality: Combinationally driven by result_select: it outputs xtea.res for recognized XTEA funct3 cases (or zero otherwise), reflecting the core's computed round result.
ports.evidence: In result_select process: result_o <= xtea.res under matched funct3 cases; other branches assign zeros.

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Combinationally reports completion: when rtype_i and funct3_i select a valid result it forwards xtea.done(1); otherwise it is '0'.
ports.evidence: valid_o <= xtea.done(1) in result_select when funct3_i matches XTEA operation; else valid_o <= '0'.

signals.name: key_mem
signals.functionality: Holds four 32-bit key words written via CSR writes; supplies key words to tmp_z (indexed by xtea.sum slices) and to csr_rdata_o for reads.
signals.evidence: key_mem reset and writes in csr_write_access; reads in csr_rdata_o <= key_mem(...) and tmp_z <= key_mem(...).

signals.name: xtea
signals.functionality: Aggregates the done, opa, opb, sum and res registers; fields are reset and updated on clock edges and read by combinational logic and result_select.
signals.evidence: signal xtea declared as record; fields assigned in xtea_core and xtea used in result_select sensitivity.

signals.name: xtea.done
signals.functionality: Bit0 is set on start and cleared each cycle; bit1 follows bit0 one cycle later. bit0 gates sum/res updates and bit1 is used as valid_o source.
signals.evidence: xtea.done reset and then xtea.done(0) <= '0'; xtea.done(1) <= xtea.done(0); xtea.done(0) <= '1' on start; used in if (xtea.done(0)='1').

signals.name: xtea.opa
signals.functionality: Captures rs1_i on start; supplies one operand to combinational tmp signals and to sum initialization in the core.
signals.evidence: xtea.opa <= rs1_i in xtea_core; tmp_* concurrent assigns read xtea.opa (slices used in tmp_x/tmp_y).

signals.name: xtea.opb
signals.functionality: Captures rs2_i on start; provides the other operand used by tmp signals and the core arithmetic.
signals.evidence: xtea.opb <= rs2_i in xtea_core start branch; tmp_* concurrent assigns read xtea.opb (slices used in tmp_x/tmp_y).

signals.name: xtea.sum
signals.functionality: Updated when done bit is set: loaded from opa or incremented/decremented by delta depending on funct3_i; its low bits index key_mem and it participates in tmp_r arithmetic.
signals.evidence: xtea.sum <= xtea.opa or xtea.sum +/- xtea_delta_c inside xtea_core; xtea.sum(1 downto 0) and (12 downto 11) index key_mem for tmp_z; used in tmp_r computation.

signals.name: xtea.res
signals.functionality: On done it captures the computed tmp_b +/- tmp_r value and thereafter serves as the source for result_o when selected by result_select.
signals.evidence: xtea.res <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(tmp_b) +/- unsigned(tmp_r)) in xtea_core; result_select uses xtea.res for result_o.

signals.name: tmp_a
signals.functionality: Combinationally selects between xtea.opb and xtea.opa based on funct3_i(0); it feeds the tmp_r arithmetic path.
signals.evidence: tmp_a <= xtea.opb when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opa; concurrent assignment.

signals.name: tmp_b
signals.functionality: Combinationally selects between xtea.opa and xtea.opb based on funct3_i(0); it is used in the final xtea.res computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_b <= xtea.opa when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opb; concurrent assignment.

signals.name: tmp_x
signals.functionality: Builds a left-shifted 32-bit value from xtea.opb(27 downto 0) or xtea.opa(27 downto 0) concatenated with "0000", selected by funct3_i(0).
signals.evidence: tmp_x <= xtea.opb(27 downto 0) & "0000" when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opa(27 downto 0) & "0000".

signals.name: tmp_y
signals.functionality: Forms a value by concatenating five zeros with xtea.opb(31 downto 5) or xtea.opa(31 downto 5) depending on funct3_i(0); it feeds tmp_r computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_y <= "00000" & xtea.opb(31 downto 5) when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else "00000" & xtea.opa(31 downto 5).

signals.name: tmp_z
signals.functionality: Combinationally reads a key_mem element indexed by slices of xtea.sum; selection variant depends on funct3_i(0) and the obtained key word feeds tmp_r.

relationship.bits: indexed by xtea.sum(1 downto 0) or xtea.sum(12 downto 11)

signals.evidence: tmp_z <= key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(xtea.sum(1 downto 0)))) when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(xtea.sum(12 downto 11))));

signals.name: tmp_r
signals.functionality: Computes (tmp_x xor tmp_y) + tmp_a, XORed with (xtea.sum + tmp_z); this intermediate feeds the clocked xtea.res computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_r <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(tmp_x xor tmp_y) + unsigned(tmp_a)) xor std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(xtea.sum) + unsigned(tmp_z)).
